Title: Mossy Oak Bottomland 2S Wader
Body (HTML): Busted seams retire more waders than anything else. The 2S Wader limits that possibility by only having two seams, a body-length seam down the side and another that runs from below the zipper and up your back. We furthered that "less is more" approach by removing excess fabric that's prone to catching on the edges of boats and pit blinds. The 4-layer laminate blocks out all forms of moisture, but lets water vapor escape so things don't get swampy when temperature or output increases. The boot construction and face fabric are more than tough enough for run-ins with sunken trees and busting sheets of ice. Years of testing were aimed at delivering the one thing we all want, waders that last -- the 2S Wader.

The 4-layer laminate blocks out all forms of moisture, but lets water vapor escape so things don't get swampy when temperature or output increases. Title: Waxed Canvas Goose Down Jacket
Body (HTML): The Waxed Canvas Goose Down Jacket builds on the proven combination of classic materials and modern performance, delivering the warmth and weather resistance you need from early season to late cold. A 10.10 oz waxed cotton canvas shell sheds wind and light moisture without sacrificing the rugged feel of traditional outerwear, while 100g of 600 fill-power natural goose down keeps you insulated through long sits and slow walks alike, reinforced throughout with antique brass YKK zippers and snap closures. A microfleece-lined collar and storm flap seal out drafts, lower hand warmer pockets with microfleece lining keep your hands ready when temperatures drop, and three chest pockets (snap-closure flap, hidden magnetic closure, and internal zippered) give you organized carry for calls, licenses, and essentials. Adjustable neoprene cuffs and a cinched bottom hem lock in heat when you need it most.

Title: Youth 2S Wader
Body (HTML): Busted seams retire more waders than anything else. The 2S Wader limits that possibility by only having two seams, a body-length seam down the side and another that runs from below the zipper and up your back. We furthered that "less is more" approach by removing excess fabric that's prone to catching on the edges of boats and pit blinds. The 4-layer laminate blocks out all forms of moisture, but lets water vapor escape so things don't get swampy when temperature or output increases. The boot construction and face fabric are more than tough enough for run-ins with sunken trees and busting sheets of ice. Years of testing were aimed at delivering the one thing we all want, waders that last -- the 2S Wader.

Title: Deception Turkey Vest
Body (HTML): Speed kills. The gear you leave in the truck doesn’t. The Deception Turkey Vest carries exactly what you need for a rip through the turkey woods without the bulk that slows you down. Purpose-built pockets let you run a full call lineup and essential gear with no compromises, while dedicated storage for a fly-down wing, decoy, and hydration keeps everything in its place. More gear helps, but hauling the kitchen sink isn’t worth losing comfort or mobility. Foam padding along the shoulders and back manages heavier loads comfortably, even when that load includes a long walk out with a bird. A quick-deploy seat stows cleanly into its own compartment, and every pocket stays streamlined so your movement remains fast, quiet, and unrestricted.
Tags: activity:turkey, audience:mens, audience:womens, audience:youth, lifecycle:new-arrival, series:deception
